source: design_system/v1_0_threejs_soulslike/ENCOUNTERS.md + TUNING_V0.md Wolves + GATES F3/F10 + DECISIONS D7/D9

wither.source: ENCOUNTERS wolf pack grammar: zero Wither application

token.source: ENCOUNTERS / TUNING_V0: one attack token per 3.5m ring; release 45t after resolution

howl.source: ENCOUNTERS: a howl escalates the pack by one. startupTicks is authoring (ART_BIBLE howl posture; F3 readable wind-up ≥12t)

lunge.source: TUNING_V0 Lunger pounce 30t startup; active/recovery 8/22 from frame_data_v0 lunge and the s14 contract (30/8/22)

harrier.source: TUNING_V0 Harrier flank bite 16t (startup). active 4 / recovery 20 are authoring so the clip has a punishable tail; F3 min wind-up is 12t

baiterFeint.source: frame_data.json wolf_baiter_feint (12/0/14). ENCOUNTERS Baiter: low commitment. startup 12t is the F3 floor. active 0 = no hit. recovery derived from the shared frame-data row, not a second table.

perception.source: authoring — PRD R4 names sight cones + sound events; TUNING_V0 has no wolf sensory table (Attend 15m/34° is the player lock-on, not wolf vision). Ranges sit between Attend acquire (15m) and retain (22m); howl radius exceeds the 25m leash so a distant packmate can escalate

roles.source: authoring geometry around the 3.5m token ring. Token score is integer so grant order is replay-stable (D7/D9). Role assignment: 1=Lunger, 2=Baiter+Lunger, 3=Baiter+Lunger+Harrier, 4+=extra Harriers

speeds.source: authoring. Player run is 6m/s (TUNING_V0); Harrier matches it, stalk/circle stay slower, flee slightly faster

nav.source: D7/D9: baked walk graph, stable A* tie-breaks (lexicographic node id), off-mesh drop links, pack slots, bounded local avoidance, crowd-failure handling. avoidanceMaxMps caps separation so paths stay replayable. arrival 0.35m matches D8 capsule radius
